fixtureManifest.snapshotPolicy: Each workload fully copies every regular source file except the excluded persisted query index into a new private temp directory; only the private mapping is opened and closed. COLD uses the initial private mapping; WARM primes that same mapping. No hardlinks. Full independent JMH forks.
fixtureManifest.comparability: Do not pool third or later isolated-fixture observations with earlier shared-writable-fixture observations. Identical revised harness and immutable fixtures required for all revisions.

targetQueries.statistics: Primary latency median of3freshJVMs perrevision; CPU/allocation are separate singleoraclequery-window observations
targetQueries.referenceScope: 8cases use unmodified main144d98ef; dynamicHit/Miss use main144d98ef plus subscript correctness repair only
targetQueries.allocationScope: Oracle allocatedBytes counts allJava-thread allocations duringquerywindow, includingbackground Java threads; notheapgrowth orpeak. JMH GC stats are wholefirsttrial includingfixturecopy/setup,WARMprimer,teardown. These scopes are not mixed.

broadRegression.correctness: No digest assertions in these existing benchmark methods; correctness evidence is separate.

fixtureManifestNote: Input manifest was created before final allocation instrumentation; final harness identity is artifacts[*].harnessSHA256.
